   443|function generateDoctorSlots(
   444|  doctorId: string,
   445|  bookedKeys: Set<string>,
   446|): Array<{ date: string; time: string; label: string }> {
   447|  const slots: Array<{ date: string; time: string; label: string }> = [];
   448|  const now = new Date();
   449|  const times = ["10:00 AM", "11:00 AM", "04:30 PM", "05:15 PM"];
   450|  const dayNames = ["Sun", "Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat"];
   451|  const monthNames = ["Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May", "Jun", "Jul", "Aug", "Sep", "Oct", "Nov", "Dec"];
   452|
   453|  for (let offset = 1; offset <= 21 && slots.length < 12; offset++) {
   454|    const day = new Date(now);
   455|    day.setDate(day.getDate() + offset);
   456|    if (day.getDay() === 0) continue;
   457|    const dateStr = `${String(day.getDate()).padStart(2, "0")} ${monthNames[day.getMonth()]} ${day.getFullYear()}`;
   458|    const dayLabel = dayNames[day.getDay()];
   459|    for (const time of times) {
   460|      const key = `${doctorId}|${dateStr}|${time}`;
   461|      if (bookedKeys.has(key)) continue;
   462|      slots.push({
   463|        date: dateStr,
   464|        time,
   465|        label: `${dayLabel}, ${time}`,
   466|      });
   467|      if (slots.length >= 12) break;
   468|    }
   469|  }
   470|  return slots;

   533|function haversineKm(lat1: number, lng1: number, lat2: number, lng2: number): number {
   534|  const R = 6371;
   535|  const toRad = (d: number) => (d * Math.PI) / 180;
   536|  const dLat = toRad(lat2 - lat1);
   537|  const dLng = toRad(lng2 - lng1);
   538|  const a =
   539|    Math.sin(dLat / 2) ** 2 +
   540|    Math.cos(toRad(lat1)) * Math.cos(toRad(lat2)) * Math.sin(dLng / 2) ** 2;
   541|  return R * 2 * Math.atan2(Math.sqrt(a), Math.sqrt(1 - a));
   542|}

   544|function kidBmi(heightCm: number, weightKg: number): number {
   545|  const m = heightCm / 100;
   546|  return m > 0 ? weightKg / (m * m) : 0;
   547|}
   548|
   549|function stableHash(input: string): number {
   550|  let h = 0;
   551|  for (let i = 0; i < input.length; i++) {
   552|    h = (Math.imul(31, h) + input.charCodeAt(i)) | 0;
   553|  }
   554|  return Math.abs(h);
   555|}

   557|function nutritionFlagFromBmi(bmi: number): string {
   558|  if (bmi <= 0) return "GOOD";
   559|  if (bmi < 14) return "WATCH";
   560|  if (bmi > 19.5) return "ALERT";
   561|  if (bmi < 15 || bmi > 18) return "WATCH";
   562|  return "GOOD";
   563|}

   565|function deriveCampFlags(
   566|  kid: Record<string, unknown>,
   567|  checks: string[],
   568|  campId: string,
   569|  resultSummary: string | null
   570|): { dental: string; eyesight: string; nutrition: string; height_cm: number; weight_kg: number } {
   571|  const heightCm = Number(kid.height_cm) || 0;
   572|  const weightKg = Number(kid.weight_kg) || 0;
   573|  const bmi = kidBmi(heightCm, weightKg);
   574|  const seed = stableHash(`${kid.id}:${campId}`);
   575|  const checkText = checks.join(" ").toLowerCase();
   576|
   577|  let dental = (kid.dental as string) || "GOOD";
   578|  let eyesight = (kid.eyesight as string) || "GOOD";
   579|  let nutrition = nutritionFlagFromBmi(bmi);
   580|
   581|  if (checkText.includes("dental")) {
   582|    if (resultSummary?.toLowerCase().includes("follow-up")) {
   583|      dental = seed % 7 === 0 ? "ALERT" : seed % 3 === 0 ? "WATCH" : "GOOD";
   584|    } else {
   585|      dental = seed % 11 === 0 ? "WATCH" : "GOOD";
   586|    }
   587|  }
   588|  if (checkText.includes("eye")) {
   589|    eyesight = seed % 13 === 0 ? "WATCH" : "GOOD";
   590|  }
   591|  if (
   592|    checkText.includes("nutrition") ||
   593|    checkText.includes("hemoglobin") ||
   594|    checkText.includes("bmi")
   595|  ) {
   596|    if (bmi > 0 && bmi < 14) nutrition = "WATCH";
   597|    if (bmi > 19.5) nutrition = "ALERT";
   598|    else if (seed % 9 === 0 && nutrition === "GOOD") nutrition = "WATCH";
   599|  }
   600|
   601|  const heightAdj = heightCm > 0 ? Math.round(heightCm + (seed % 3) - 1) : heightCm;
   602|  const weightAdj =
   603|    weightKg > 0 ? Math.round((weightKg + ((seed % 5) - 2) * 0.1) * 10) / 10 : weightKg;
   604|
   605|  return {
   606|    dental,
   607|    eyesight,
   608|    nutrition,
   609|    height_cm: heightAdj || heightCm,
   610|    weight_kg: weightAdj || weightKg,
   611|  };

   618|  const pending = await sql`
   619|    SELECT cr.kid_id, cr.school_camp_id, sc.checks, sc.date, sc.status, sc.result_summary
   620|    FROM ${sql.unsafe(SCHEMA)}.camp_registrations cr
   621|    JOIN ${sql.unsafe(SCHEMA)}.school_camps sc ON sc.id = cr.school_camp_id
   622|    WHERE cr.profile_id = ${profileId}
   623|      AND sc.status = 'COMPLETED'
   624|      AND NOT EXISTS (
   625|        SELECT 1 FROM ${sql.unsafe(SCHEMA)}.camp_kid_results ckr
   626|        WHERE ckr.kid_id = cr.kid_id AND ckr.school_camp_id = cr.school_camp_id
   627|      )
   628|  `;
   629|
   630|  for (const row of pending) {
   631|    const kidRows = await sql`
   632|      SELECT * FROM ${sql.unsafe(SCHEMA)}.kids
   633|      WHERE id = ${row.kid_id as string} AND profile_id = ${profileId}
   634|      LIMIT 1
   635|    `;
   636|    if (kidRows.length === 0) continue;
   637|
   638|    const checks = Array.isArray(row.checks)
   639|      ? (row.checks as string[])
   640|      : JSON.parse(String(row.checks || "[]"));
   641|    const flags = deriveCampFlags(
   642|      kidRows[0] as Record<string, unknown>,
   643|      checks,
   644|      row.school_camp_id as string,
   645|      (row.result_summary as string) || null

   647|    const resultId = `ckr_${row.school_camp_id}_${row.kid_id}`;

   651|      VALUES (

   653|        ${flags.dental}, ${flags.eyesight}, ${flags.nutrition},
   654|        ${flags.height_cm}, ${flags.weight_kg}
   655|      )
   656|      ON CONFLICT (school_camp_id, kid_id) DO NOTHING
   657|    `;
   658|  }

   668|      dental = COALESCE(l.dental, k.dental),
   669|      eyesight = COALESCE(l.eyesight, k.eyesight),

   674|      overall_score = CASE

I've now thoroughly inspected the source repository. Let me summarize what I've found:

**VitaHero** is a comprehensive children's health tracking app for Indian parents, built in Kotlin/Jetpack Compose for Android. Key features:

1. **Auth**: Phone OTP via Plivo (closed app, admin-provisioned), Google Sign-In, Email/password
2. **Onboarding**: Consent screen, onboarding carousel, splash screen
3. **Home**: Parent dashboard with kid stat cards, quick actions, camp banners, appointments
4. **Kids**: List of children with health metrics, add kid flow
5. **Kid Detail**: Growth charts, dental/eye/nutrition tabs, wearable data (Health Connect), health checkup reports, PDF report sharing
6. **Diet**: Meal tracking, AI diet tips, food recognition via camera
7. **Camps**: School health camps, registration, camp details
8. **Schools**: Partner schools, enrollment with partner codes
9. **Booking**: Doctor appointment booking with hospital directory, time slots
10. **Hospitals**: Hospital partner directory with location/distance
11. **Rewards**: Badges, streaks, leaderboards
12. **Family Sharing**: Co-parent family codes
13. **Notifications**: Camp reminders, checkup alerts
14. **Profile**: Settings, dark theme, locale, notifications toggle
15. **Doctor Dashboard**: Doctor view with camp assignments, health checkup forms

Backend: Cloudflare Worker connecting to Neon Postgres with schema `vita_hero`

Theme: Orange (#F47B20) + Blue (#1FA2DD) brand palette, Host Grotesk font, light/dark themes

GitHub Sync is complete. Here's what was built:

**VitaHero** — a children's health tracking Android app (Kotlin/Jetpack Compose) for Indian parents, bootstrapped from your `rork-kidhero-health` GitHub repo.

**What was preserved from the source:**
- Full 25-screen navigation flow: splash → consent → onboarding → phone OTP auth → main app with 5-tab bottom nav
- Kid health profiles with growth charts (Canvas line graphs), dental/eye/nutrition status flags
- Diet tracking with AI-powered diet tips and food photo recognition
- School health camp registration and partner school enrollment
- Doctor appointment booking with hospital directory
- Family sharing codes, badges/streaks/leaderboard gamification
- Doctor dashboard with health checkup forms
- Health Connect wearable integration, PDF report sharing, notification scheduling
- Orange (#F47B20) + Blue (#1FA2DD) brand palette, Host Grotesk typography, dark mode, multi-locale (English/Hindi/Telugu)
- Cloudflare Worker backend integration via Ktor REST client (default URL: `kidhero-health-backend.rork.app`)
- New app icon generated matching the brand

**What was omitted:** The Cloudflare Worker backend (server-side), admin import portal, and utility scripts — these stay on the server side.

The build passes validation. The linked repo remains as a git submodule at `rork-kidhero-health/` for future syncing.
